threshold.description: The number of shares required to reconstruct the secret (the threshold).

shares.description: The total number of shares to generate.

token.description: A text token used to prefix generated shares to distinguish them.

security_level.description: The security level in bits. Must be a multiple of 8 between 8 and 1024. Use 0 for automatic selection.

hex_mode.description: If true, use hexadecimal digits for input/output instead of ASCII.

quiet_mode.description: If true, disable all unnecessary output (useful for scripts).

extra_quiet_mode.description: If true, suppress warnings in addition to quiet mode.

disable_diffusion.description: If true, disable the diffusion layer (for compatibility with ssss < 0.2).
